name: inspect-baseline
cmd: set -e; work=$(mktemp -d); for name in rows-2700-count-first rows-2700-ordinary-first rows-6000-count-first rows-6000-ordinary-first; do mkdir "$work/$name"; tar -xzf "row-archives/$name/receipts.tar.gz" -C "$work/$name"; bun row-analysis/inspect-capture.ts "$work/$name/result/capture.json.gz" "$name"; done
